successors.name: Kingdom of Northumbria
successors.text: 'the realm was incorporated into Northumbria on Easter in 627'; overrun by Edwin in 616 or 617

ledger.x: Elmet: 'a Brythonic kingdom thought to have been an independent polity between the 5th century'; the page gives no founding year, so 450 is a bridge (confidence 1).

wars.name: Edwin's conquest of Elmet
wars.outcome: Ceretic expelled; Elmet becomes a Northumbrian territory (the Elmetsaete of the Tribal Hidage).

certainty.note: The page names towns and counties, no frontier.
